# Specialized Medical

> Specialized Medical LLC provides nationwide ambulatory cardiac monitoring support for physician practices, cardiology groups, hospitals and health systems.

## S-Patch facts

- S-Patch is a compact dual-disk wearable ECG monitoring system with one thin connecting lead.
- Stated weight: 0.6 oz.
- Stated battery duration: minimum 10 days.
- Water-resistance rating: IP55.
- Supported wear duration: up to 30 days under the prescribed workflow.
- Supported study paths include Holter, Long-Term Holter, Extended Holter, Cardiac Event Monitoring and Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
- Supported live workflows use a dedicated cellular phone for ECG transmission and operational test-status visibility.
